lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a grid-like pattern where the high-luminance blobs are positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp horizontal boundary with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of smaller, lower-intensity spots that contrast with the larger, higher-intensity blobs on the main lateral flank.
